title: Treat task context as maintained project material
text: The supplied 10X cheatsheet describes conventions, project specifications, active work and logs as maintained Markdown artifacts. It also distinguishes a manually asserted completion status from one derived from outstanding work. This is useful for detecting stale context and falsely complete projects.
qualification: Derived cheatsheet from the same episode, not independent evidence. Exact terminology and speaker wording require video verification.
